name: wwii-sky-composite
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:

· PHOTOGRAPHY: a hyper-sharp cinematic composite photograph shot from an extreme LOW WORM'S-EYE ANGLE with a wide lens, subject looming large and heroic in the lower foreground, deep depth of field so both foreground and distant sky stay crisp.

· COMPOSITE: a busy swarm of vintage WWII propeller fighter planes and helicopters montaged across the whole sky at varied scales, plus streaking motion-blurred debris, giving a dense war-epic collage feel.
· GROUND: a sunlit high-desert landscape with spiky Joshua trees and pale dry earth on the right, open expanse behind.
· LIGHT: bright hard midday sun, warm rim light on the subject, punchy contrast, glossy specular highlights on skin and plastic.
· PALETTE: rich TEAL-to-CYAN sky with drifting white clouds, OLIVE / ARMY-GREEN foreground, warm skin tones, dusty sage and sand desert greens and browns.
· MOOD: chaotic, defiant, apocalyptic-heroic, blockbuster movie-poster energy.
· GRAIN: subtle photographic grain, faint vignette darkening the corners, slightly boosted saturation and clarity.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
